title: This Lizard Squirts Blood From Its Eyes Up to 5 Feet

scenes.text: This lizard shoots blood out of its eyes.
It's the short-horned lizard. The stream can travel up to five feet.
It chokes off blood leaving its head, so pressure bursts tiny vessels around its eyes.
The blood drives off dogs, coyotes and foxes.
Some lizards may lose about a third of their blood this way.
Too small to fight, so it fires. Watch that eye again.

description:
The short-horned lizard can squirt blood from its eyes up to five feet.
It raises pressure in its head until tiny vessels burst, and the blood drives off dogs, coyotes and foxes.
Would you fight a lizard that does this?
first_comment: Which animal has the strangest defense you know of?
